title: A little more Vegas, a little more machinery
summary: Lucky Five gets a proper vintage cabinet, warm chasing bulbs and mechanical sound feedback.
notes: Spin a nickel-trimmed walnut machine with recessed glass, a sloped shelf, cashbox lock and a working beacon.
Hear the lever latch, ratcheting reels, individual stops, payout coins and winning bell through the sound-effects controls.
Watch the lever spring back and the marquee celebrate a winning result.
